excluded_sessions_note: Verification of the routine itself (2026-09-19): the iteration-cap stop, the approval-gate behaviour, the file-script path, the wall-clock stop, and the scheduler-fired probe. They are tagged scout-research like any session, so they are excluded here by id from both the weekly cap and the allowance - they measured the mechanism rather than doing research. Listed explicitly so the exclusion is auditable; delete entries once they age out.
notes: 5 USD/month of Hermes-ESTIMATED model spend for scheduled research sessions, resetting on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. Every figure is an estimate: Hermes records cost_status='estimated' and actual_cost_usd=0, and it cannot see the NousCloud subscription quota, its usage page or its reset period. This is a budget guard on planned work and must never be presented as enforcement of the subscription. Separate from the 20 EUR/month Hetzner worker allowance. Session limits: hermes chat --max-turns and --run-budget are ENFORCED per run; the token figure is ADVISORY (no runtime token control), with an overshoot counting double against the weekly cap. reserve_usd is held back so the next session stays affordable.
